page.layout: One block of running text in a single column, with a printer's ornament centred below it. Printed page number at the head. Catchword "DE" at the lower right.

main_text.p: neque scriptis ab Allatio refcripferit, sed in rabiem versus, aliorum verbis insulsissime, & extra rem obganniens chartas oppleuerit, plane deprehensus est, ἀλαζονείας πολύξοπον τῇ πνιγῇ[?], καὶ τῇ Σοφίστῃ τῆς κακίας[?]. Habes iam Hottingere, & quicunque alius, qui similia consensui nostro opponit, rationes aliquando etiam repetitas inculcatasque, pro vt opponentium calumniae deposcebant. plurimae praeferri possent, si tam imperitorum ardelionum lucubrationes dignae essent, quae semel, atque iterum lectae ad amussim examinarentur. Quibus lectis cui non persuasum fuerit, tantam esse Hottingeri inscitiam, quanta illorum esse potest, qui nec ingenij, aut iudicij acumine, nec multa, accurataque lectione sunt commendandi; ἀλλὰ ταῦτα μὲν καὶ πέρα τῆς μάχης[?].

page.notes: The printer's ornament between the text and the catchword is not text and is not transcribed. Greek passages are reproduced from a small scan; the Greek words marked [?] are uncertain. Long s was read as f in several words ("infulfiffime", "perfuasum", "poteft", "amuf fim") and has been written as plain s. The running head is absent. The page number 679 is printed at the head.
